caption:
Toto's training is going well, but a stiff mid-back is stopping his arms going fully overhead.

When stiffness blocks training, hands-on care can often help it feel easier in the short term. That's the window to move: the exercises you do afterwards help you hold onto the change.

Most training niggles come from doing a bit too much, too soon, so your chiropractor should ask about your training week, not just your spine. At Hybrid Physio our chiropractors work alongside physios, Pilates and remedial massage, and refer in-house when that suits you better.

Pain after a fall, numbness or weakness, or night pain that won't ease needs a thorough assessment first. Book online via the link in bio 🐰

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
